scope.literal_models: Exact res:// references in coop scripts and resources, including dictionaries used by load().
scope.grove_models: coop/world.json species expanded against coop/grove.gd STAGES.
scope.streamed_models: coop/world.json chunks loaded by coop/terrain.gd; selected directory checked on disk.
scope.global_texture_dependencies: Direct textures and dynamic inventory icons; GLB texture uses are in each model.

runtime_overrides.streamed_terrain: coop/terrain.gd SURFACES replaces materials by mesh name.
runtime_overrides.grass_instances: coop/grass.gd applies grass.gdshader and grass_medium_01.png to mesh variants.
runtime_overrides.shoreline_instances: coop/coast_scene.gd creates rock, tree and fern batches and assigns terrain/ocean shaders.
runtime_overrides.lake_geometry: coop/lake.gd and coop/lake_bed.gd generate water, lake-bed, pondweed and ripple geometry.
runtime_overrides.rigged_equipment: coop/hiker.gd attaches or drives boots, hats, garment rigs and backpack; wild_people_scene.gd attaches weapons to grip_R/grip_L.

scope.limits: Counts are file metadata, not submitted frame triangles. Visibility, skinning, engine LOD, post-import materials and live behaviour need independent runtime checks.

mesh_details.name: Root spurs, knots and forked boughs
